About

La Clé is a refined creative lifestyle management studio and exclusive travel members club dedicated to curating exceptional escapes across our signature destinations: Mykonos, Montenegro and Croatia.

We design experiences that go far beyond travel. Whether you envision a private villa overlooking the Aegean shaped by the rhythm of the Meltemi wind or seamless access to the most exclusive beach clubs, hidden gatherings, and cultural moments — every detail is arranged with precision.

Our perspective is rooted in true insider knowledge. This is not a preset itinerary — it is your world, unlocked.

From Mykonos, your journey can extend seamlessly. Sail by private boat to Montenegro, then continue along the Adriatic to Croatia's timeless coastline.

With La Clé, you don't simply travel — you immerse yourself, completely and meaningfully.

Exclusively Yours

Private Concierge Services

At La Clé, luxury villas meet concierge excellence, creating the ultimate address for discerning travelers seeking a flawlessly curated experience. More than a destination service, La Clé is your one-stop gateway to bespoke travel design, tailored entirely to your lifestyle, preferences, and desires.

Whether you envision immersing yourself in the vibrant sophistication of Mykonos — indulging in the island's most exclusive dining venues, beach clubs, and elite events — or prefer the freedom of sailing through the hidden gems of Croatia and Montenegro, discovering authentic culture, cuisine, and even exceptional real estate opportunities, every detail is meticulously arranged for you.

From securing the most exquisite private villas to organizing yacht charters, private aviation, and luxury ground transportation, La Clé delivers seamless access to the extraordinary. We curate unforgettable moments through privileged reservations at the finest restaurants and events, while also crafting intimate surprise celebrations designed exclusively for you.

At La Clé, the sky is not the limit — and neither are you.

This is why you have come to La Clé.
